facts.text: The rooms are furnished in Florentine style.
facts.excerpt: The rooms furnished in Florentine style and the exclusive collection of luxury watches make this hotel the ideal solution for a stay in the heart of Florence.

facts.text: The hotel has an exclusive collection of luxury watches.
facts.excerpt: The rooms furnished in Florentine style and the exclusive collection of luxury watches make this hotel the ideal solution for a stay in the heart of Florence.

facts.text: The Junior Suite is inspired by rare pieces in the vintage Vacheron Constantin and Rolex watch collections.
facts.excerpt: Our Junior Suite is inspired by rare pieces in the vintage Vacheron Constantin and Rolex watch collections

facts.text: The Suite Rooftop Terrace is on the top floor, with a view of the Duomo and access to a large private terrace.
facts.excerpt: A unique suite situated on the top floor, it features a breathtaking view of the ‘Duomo’ and accesses a large private terrace from where one may admire Florence and its monuments from up high.

facts.text: Some Deluxe rooms have views of the Piazza and Church of Santa Maria Novella or of the Florence Cathedral.
facts.excerpt: Allow yourself the luxury of sleeping in Florence with breathtaking views of the Piazza and Church of Santa Maria Novella or enjoy picturesque vistas of the Florence Cathedral - Il Duomo - from the windows of our Deluxe rooms.

facts.text: Deluxe rooms overlook historic Florentine streets with vistas such as the Croce al Trebbio, the Medici Chapels, the Canto di Mondragone and Forte Belvedere.
facts.excerpt: The Deluxe rooms of the Hotel L'Orologio overlook historic Florentine streets, framing lesser-known vistas of great artistic and architectural interest, such as the Croce al Trebbio, the Medici Chapels, the Canto di Mondragone and Forte Belvedere.

facts.text: The hotel offers a Honeymoon Suite for romantic stays.
facts.excerpt: The special Honeymoon Suite is ideal for a romantic and unforgettable stay.

facts.text: The hotel directly overlooks Piazza Santa Maria Novella, home to one of the city's most important basilicas.
facts.excerpt: directly overlooking the square where stands one of the most important basilicas of the city

facts.text: The Ponte Vecchio, Piazza della Signoria, the Cathedral with Giotto's bell tower and the Baptistery are within easy reach of the hotel.
facts.excerpt: The Ponte Vecchio, Piazza della Signoria, the Cathedral of Santa Maria del Fiore with Giotto's bell tower and the baptistery of St. John: all the famous attractions and the thousand different sights that Florence has to offer are within easy reach of our hotel.

facts.text: Bar de l'O is a bistro with intimate lighting, a large central mahogany bar and sitting areas with armchairs.
facts.excerpt: A bistro with intimate and suffused lighting is characterised by its large central mahogany bar and comfortable sitting areas with armchairs and wooden coffee tables.

facts.text: The hotel has a sauna, a gym and a smoking room.
Pets are accepted in the rooms and common spaces with no additional fee.
facts.excerpt: At our hotel pets are accepted both in the rooms and in the common spaces with no additional fee.

facts.text: The hotel offers a Family Room for families.
facts.excerpt: Travelling with the whole Family, in the hearth of Florence surrounded by all the comforts and small luxury optional extras, choose our Family room.

facts.text: Superior rooms are characterised by essential selections, geometric precision and fine furnishings.
facts.excerpt: Essential selections, geometric precision and fine furnishings are the characteristics of our Superior rooms.

facts.text: The hotel offers a Steel Suite with cathedral views.
Guests can watch the sunset redden the roofs of the old town and the Santa Maria Novella area.
facts.excerpt: enjoying the sunset reddening the roofs of the old town and of the whole area of Santa Maria Novella is indeed a pleasure that few other hotels in Florence will be able to offer you

facts.text: The hotel's address is Piazza di Santa Maria Novella, 35R, Florence.
facts.excerpt: Piazza di Santa Maria Novella, 35R, Florence 50123
